data.name: Lois
data.gender_notes: Lois is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'lō' (help) and 'yesh' (God), Lois means 'helpful' or 'dedicated to God'. In the New Testament, Lois is the name of Timothy's grandmother, who raised him with his mother Eunice in the faith. Together, they passed on the love for God and the teachings of Paul to the young Timothy, shaping him into a key figure in early Christianity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dedication to God and helping others in need
data.etymology: Lois belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “helpful, dedication.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lois total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: לויס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לויס הוא שם נשי שמקורו בשפה היוונית ומשמעותו 'טובה', 'יותר טוב', או 'משובח'. השם לויס מוזכר בברית החדשה, בספר תימוטיוס, כהשם של סבתו של תימוטיוס, שהיה תלמידו של פאולוס. השם לויס משמש כזכרון לטובתה ולייחוסה של האישה הנושאת אותו.

in_greek.name: Λοΐς
in_greek.long_meaning: Λοΐς (Loïs) είναι ένα γυναικείο όνομα ελληνικής προέλευσης, που σημαίνει 'καλή', 'βελτίων' (καλύτερη), ή 'ἄριστη' (η καλύτερη). Στο Χριστιανισμό, η Λοΐς αναφέρεται στη γιαγιά του Τιμόθεου, μαθητή του Παύλου, όπως αναφέρεται στη Β΄ Επιστολή προς Τιμόθεον. Το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την αρετή και την αξιοπρέπεια της γυναίκας που το φέρει.

in_latin.name: Lois
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lois origine Graeco, significationem habet 'bona', 'melior', vel 'optima'. In Ecclesia Christiana, Lois commemoratur ut avia Timothei, discipuli Pauli, in Epistola II ad Timotheum. Hoc nomen virtutem et dignitatem mulieris quae illud gerit, denotat.

in_english.name: Lois
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lois originates from the Greek language, meaning 'desirable', 'better', or 'excellent'. It is mentioned in the New Testament, in the Second Epistle to Timothy, as the name of Timothy's grandmother, who was a Christian and a model of faith. The name Lois symbolizes virtue, excellence, and spiritual maturity. It has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting the values of goodness, kindness, and devotion. Throughout history, the name Lois has been associated with positive qualities and is still used today in many English-speaking countries.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lois has been cherished throughout history, particularly in Christian communities. It represents a strong, devoted women who have dedicated themselves to helping others and living a faithful life. Lois often appears in literature and media as a loving and nurturing figure, reflecting the caring and giving qualities that are associated with the name.
data.spiritual_significance: Lois, derived from the Hebrew meaning 'helpful' and 'dedicated to God', carries a rich spiritual significance. It reminds us of the importance of being a helper and a faithful servant to others, while also being devoted to our faith and relationship with God. The name Lois highlights the importance of passing on our values, beliefs, and the love of God to future generations, as depicted in the Biblical tale of Lois and her role in raising Timothy.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lois in Greek means "lofty, noble". In a spiritual sense, it symbolizes a woman of great character and strength, exemplifying the virtues of faith, love, and wisdom. She is a beacon of light, inspiring others to aspire to higher ideals.

biblical_reference.note: The name Lois is mentioned in the New Testament as the grandmother of Timothy.

historical_references.reference: In the New Testament of the Bible, Lois is mentioned as the grandmother of Timothy. She and Timothy's mother, Eunice, are credited with instructing Timothy in the Jewish-Christian faith.
Lois was also the name of a 13th-century French saint, known for her charitable works and devotion to the poor. She founded a hospital in Tours and was remembered for her compassion and generosity.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Christian name 'Lois' has seen a resurgence in popularity in modern times due to its rich history and meanings. Lois is a classic name with biblical origins, meaning 'loyalty' or 'help'. It is often seen as a grand, elegant name suitable for older women, adding to its appeal. On social media, influencers and content creators have been promoting the name as a timeless and beautiful choice for babies. Baby name websites also feature Lois as a trending name, with parents looking for unique and meaningful names for their children. In fiction novels, Lois is a common name for strong and independent female characters, further adding to its modern context and appeal.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Lois, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Lois meaning "helpful, dedication" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
